description:
Friendship management tool for VRChat


Additions
- Login with QRCode.
- New Moderation reports, Group invites, Blocked groups, VRChat Store, Purchase History and Info Push dialogs in tools.
- Create/edit/view group roles and permissions.
- Edit group galleries in group dialog.
- Edit avatar gallery in avatar dialog.
- Link/unlink events to group instances.
- Notify and redeem new free store items and VRC+ bundles when they become available.
- Rename instance button.
- Instance tooltip, list language ratios of users in the instance.
- Add world dialog store tab.
- Add avatar marketplace to search tab.
- Add purchased avatars to current user dialog avatars tab.
- Option to hide closed instances from world dialog.
- Option to auto accept invites only with selected statuses.
- Pause animated images when tabbing out.
- Memo in playerList.
- Warning about disabled notifications when status is set to Busy.
- Show expand sidebar button when friends sidebar is hidden.
- Option to export only public avatar ID's.'
- Add Reduced Profile Animations option to user dialog.
- Add own account standing badge.
- Add total instance count to online player count.
- In app password reset.
- Add instance icon for hype train.
- Popup for VRCVideoCacher when getting a YouTube cookie related error.
- Add displaying empty session segments in Game Log View #1947
- Fix filter skip being removed #1948
- World creators can now make use of https://protv.dev/guides/nowplaying

Changes
- UI overhaul for group moderations, boop and config.json dialogs.
- Better handling of rowIds, should help with performance/memory issues.
- Move dialog tooltips to the right.
- Remove setting profilePicOverride from gallery, profilePicOverride is no longer used.
- Disable tab heading text wrapping #1760
- Add back copy ID to clipboard buttons on dialogs.
- Keep friends sidebar open when opening friends locations tab.
- Change some settings to dropdowns to fit better when using different languages.
- Add back "auto fit image" option for uploading images.
- Make use of vrchat.community types.
- Fetch all user bios with friendList "Load missing entries".
- Avatar dialog share dropdown.
- Deprecate delete moderation button.

Fixes
- Fix being stuck traveling.
- Fix bio in feed, it wont update as often anymore due to VRC API changes.
- Fix showing user icon as an avatar image.
- Fix setting user icon from gallery.
- Fix playerList bio links.
- Fix friendList bio search and bio links.
- Fix laggy gameLog session view search.
- Fix user icon full size image preview.
- Fix current user "offline for".
- Fix notification mark as seen.
- Fix export Discord dialog.
- Fix updater sometimes not listing any versions.
- Fix sidebar hiding on next start.
- Missing names fallback to ID.
- PR: Fix group member search #1934

Linux/macOS
- Fix Electron system theme.
